idea-plugin.name: Web Live Dock
idea-plugin.description:
Web Live Dock brings an embedded Chromium preview and a real-time client web console directly into the bottom tool window of WebStorm, PhpStorm, and IntelliJ-based IDEs.

Eliminate permanent context switching between your code editor and external browser windows. Designed specifically for modern web frameworks including Nuxt, Vue, Vite, Next.js, and React.

Key Features

  • Responsive Simulator & Tailwind CSS Breakpoints: Switch seamlessly between standard viewports (Mobile <sm 390px, sm: 640px, md: 768px, lg: 1024px, xl: 1280px, 2xl: 1536px) to test adaptive media queries instantly.
  • Auto-Fit Height Mode: Automatically calculates the optimal zoom scale so your entire mockup (mobile, tablet, desktop) fits inside the bottom dock height with zero vertical scrolling.
  • Real-Time Client Web Console: Captures JavaScript console output (console.log, console.error, Vue/Nuxt warnings, SSR hydration mismatches) alongside your live preview.
  • Jump to Source Code: Double-click any log message to open the corresponding source file and line directly in your editor.
  • Toggle Console: Hide or show the web console in one click to give 100% of the dock width to the browser preview.
  • Flexible Layout Orientation: Switch instantly between side-by-side (horizontal) and stacked (vertical) viewports.
  • Official Chromium DevTools: Inspect DOM elements, network requests, and storage in a dedicated window.
  • Hot Module Replacement (HMR): Full WebSocket support for instant hot reload whenever you save your code.

Crafted by Kothea Studio for a seamless development experience.
